author: Samsung
description:
This is the official video introducing AI Energy Mode of the Bespoke AI WindFree Pro, Samsung's new room air conditioner.

Enjoy up to 30% actual energy savings with AI Energy Mode! By using AI to analyze your usage patterns and external conditions, AI Energy Mode prevents sudden stops or increases in the compressor’s frequency.

Q: How can I activate AI Energy Mode? 
A: It works only when “AI Energy mode” is activated in the SmartThings App under AI Auto mode operation.  Therefore, turn on “AI Energy mode” on the SmartThings Energy tap, and select "AI Auto mode" by pressing the "AI" button on the remote.
